target: Extend the predecessor's named target ceiling to Entity or Value Object, alongside an Interface-owned qualified public contract. Retain the target selector and canonical maps edge; a public contract is never converted into a synthetic domain declaration.
projection: Produce the explicitly selected field projection, not a constructed domain instance. Do not execute target factories, Rules, invariants, persistence or behavior. Exact property types and total field coverage are still checked.
unchanged: All predecessor identity, field, default, type, public closure and member-use rules remain unchanged. Only the target ceiling and its selected definition identity change. No implicit structural substitution or optional traversal is added.
selection: Select these exact successor bytes to compile a Value Object target. The predecessor remains available with its narrower ceiling and is not silently reinterpreted. Checked mappings and language plans bind the actual selected definition digest.
intuition: A mapper may assemble the fields expected by a value object. That alone does not certify the business invariants of a constructed value object.
